_comment: Overrides and additions for the built-in codebook. A code listed here is merged onto its default; unknown numbers become new codes.

codes.title: Suspected spy
codes.meaning: Someone in this channel is suspected of spying on the server.
codes.response: **Code 8 — suspected spy.** Operators pinged. Nobody say anything sensitive in this channel until it is cleared. Watch who reacts and who goes quiet.

codes.title: Getting found out
codes.meaning: The sender believes they are being discovered right now.
codes.response: **Code 10 — operator is being found out.** Trigger message removed. Operators, check your DMs and assume this channel is watched. Do not reply to the sender here.
